messages:
zoe: Quick thread  partners asking for a chained-embargo plan so marketplace GA, vendor press, and SI demos don't step on each other. Can we draft rules?

pat: I'll sketch rules. Idea: anchor to marketplace GA -> 72h quiet window global, with APAC extension to 96h. SI exclusives carve out separate demo lanes (max 2/day/vendor).

rahul: Ops constraints: APAC racks show periodic thermal derate Tue/Thu mornings. Recommend reserving alternate GA slots for APAC or using MI300 fallback images.

emily: Comms preference: hard block for any two public vendor posts within 48h in APAC, advisory 24h in US/EU. Also need a simple waiver workflow for embargo exceptions.

ops-bot: Created doc link: https://redwood.company/docs/partners/chained-embargoes-v1 (reviewers: pat, emily).

zoe: Also: SI partners asking for exclusive demo days. Rah: can we support 2 exclusives/vendor without breaking GA commitments?

rahul: Maybe if we shift some GA capacity to low-priority B200 images for non-critical workloads. Otherwise must push GA by 2-3 days in certain regions.

pat: Draft matrix request: region | preferred | fallback | embargo-window. Keep it compact.

emily: I'll add waiver flow and template email for partners.

zoe: Action items: pat - draft rules + matrix (EOD), rahul - thermal & fallback feasibility (tomorrow), emily - embargo waiver template (tomorrow). Recheck in 24h.

pat: One more: tag images `redwood/ga-fallback:mi300-quant` and ensure routing policy can failover on 5m latency spike. Ops to confirm.

ops-bot: Task created: /tasks/41200 - "APAC thermal derate watch & MI300 fallback image" assigned to infra-team.

zoe: Thanks all. Keep notes short in the doc so partners can review quickly. If any firmware driver risk shows up flag immediately.
